    Manages budget-related operations including setting limits and tracking usage.

    Service class that handles all budget-related calculations and logic.

    The graphical interface for managing a user's budget.

    Utility service for handling currency conversions within the application.

    The main navigation hub of the application.

    Graphical interface for creating and tracking savings goals.

    Represents an income transaction in the budget application.

    The initial landing page of the application for user authentication.

    The main entry point for the Budget Management Application.

    Controller responsible for generating financial reports for users.

    ReportView
